text: Dad can u grab groceries tmrw?? Or should I go 🛒
I can do it. What's on the list
Mom sent a list lol. Its long
[photo: handwritten list]
Got it. I'm at the store till 5 tomorrow so I'll go after. Bring bags this time
Thank you Sarah. Do not buy the cheap flour, like last time.
She means the store brand flour.
Ok noted
Long day. Guy came in wanting a refund on a water heater valve he'd installed upside down. Took an hour to get him out the door
Anyway. Sarah are you coming for Christmas or doing the thing in Burnaby again
Prob christmas eve? Depends on school stuff. Still deciding
Is michael coming to christmas or no idea
He has not said.
I'll ask him. He was at the site late, he might still be asleep
Patricia's going to bed. I'm going to read a bit. Sarah, groceries tomorrow fine, leave the list on the fridge if I'm not up
I'll come for Christmas Eve dinner. Not the whole day
Ok thanks michael
Store till 5. I'll do groceries after
Ok 👍 thx dad
Michael. Christmas Eve is fine. Your mother wants you there by 5. She's doing the turkey breast this year, not the whole bird
Ok
Will be there
Guy called again about the deck screws. Wants the store to take back a whole box because they "don't fit his deck." I sold him the exact ones he asked for. Told him no. Long day already
Peter, the flour. Not the cheap one.
I know
Dad did u get the cheese
Groceries done. Got the flour. Left the bags in the car, will bring them in
Which cheese is it. The list says Gruyère but there are three kinds
Gruyère, Peter. Not the one in the red wrapper.
Got it
Thanks for doing it dad 🙏
Bags are in the kitchen. Patricia says the bread is wrong but she'll tell you tomorrow
Goodnight.
Reading a bit, then bed
Store opens at 7. Patricia says the bread was wrong. Which bread
The sourdough. Not the sliced one in the bag.
Ok
[photo: site hoarding, crane tipped over the lane]
Crane got pulled off the Kingsway job for wind. Inspector's here till 4 so probably a long one
Oof hope not
Have u eaten
Pallet of road salt came in. Sold 40 bags in the first hour. Everybody in Vancouver thinks it's going to snow
It might.
Ate a granola bar in the truck. Counts
Closing up at 5. Patricia, bread from Lucia's or the big place on Commercial
Lucia's. Ask for the sourdough, not the rye.
Lucia's
Inspector signed off on the crane. Coming back Wed
Ok good
Got a call from the tree lot. Tree's coming Dec 12. Patricia wants the big one again
Not too big. It has to fit in the front room.
Last year it fit
Last year it leaned.
Can someone tell me if the 99 is still running after 10 or is it just me
Still running. Stops at Broadway though
Ugh thx
Goodnight.
Reading a bit, then bed
